releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.8.0 — UI Layout, Padding & Complete Text Visibility:
• Fixed all overlapping UI elements: standardized card heights, vertical offsets, and button paddings.
• Fixed text truncation: multi-line descriptions now auto-wrap cleanly with full explanations visible.
• Re-parented Network and Startup cards into System Tools hub.
• Fully sanitized all button icons and sub-category pills.
• OmniNeural v4 (18-Agent Autonomous Mesh) fully active.
• Scrollable In-App Update Dialog with fixed bottom buttons.
